text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy, I spotted Air Messiah staring intensely at her smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Not this one... either. This page is a miss too...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm trying to look up a song that's stuck in my head, but I only heard it once and don't know the title...
choice_data_list: Sounds like you have very few clues...
Sounds like you have very few clues...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However, taking things step-by-step is my forte. I'll just keep at it diligently.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ......Is she still looking that up?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...As always, horribly inefficient.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Searching "club music famous"... Lots of hits popped up. Alright, starting from the first page...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ What are you looking around for? Your meal is going to get cold, you know?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ! ...Shut up. Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, a book that hasn't been digitized, what a pain... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "The 4 representative genres of club music originated from different locations—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see! I thought of searching by genre, but the origins of each one are so fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, where the hell are you even starting your search from...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... Found it! This song, this is the one!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (...Finally. Geez, how much time did that take—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That was tough... But I learned so much about EDM, HOUSE, and recent trends.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I even found some unexpected new favorite tracks... and the unique traits of the artists were really interesting.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: With this, I should be able to narrow down any song that catches my interest!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Some results can only be reached precisely because you painstakingly fed it data"... huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ......Hah, geez.
While walking through the academy, I spotted Air Shakur typing away on her laptop.
choice_data_list: You're recording detailed data, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Don't stare at my screen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You over there, how long are you gonna keep lurking around?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! I'm sorry, I thought I shouldn't disturb you...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Painstakingly piling up data is what fits your nature, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then come fetch the data you need to feed yourself on your own.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-Yes!
choice_data_list: That's a roundabout way of putting it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. Spoken like a true softie.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And yet... it is an accurate analysis. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, not at all. ...Right now, I have nothing but gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
